note: Machine form of Appendix A: A.0, A.1, A.4, and the A.2 fields an A.4 row or A.1 note names. An authored display-tier vocabulary: never tested against outcomes, never a rank, gate or forecast. A change to `artifacts`, `fields`, `paths`, `families` or `retired_condition_ids` is a new mapping version.

paths.assumption_en: Inflation pressure eases without broad deterioration in labour or credit.

conditions.statement_en: The recent pace of core inflation is below its 12-month pace
conditions.rationale: "Inflation pressure eases" is this owner's own comparison

conditions.statement_en: Market-implied inflation expectations are drifting down against the model estimate (5-year-5-year-forward breakeven against a 5-year model)
conditions.rationale: The parent names expectations without a side; reading `drifting down` as the side that fits is this mapping's authored choice (RI-3 is its mirror). `anchored` is the owner's dead-band and says nothing either way

conditions.statement_en: The labour read is firm
conditions.rationale: "Without broad deterioration in labour"

conditions.statement_en: The owner's credit-stress flag is off
conditions.rationale: "Without broad deterioration in credit"; guarded by R-C

conditions.statement_en: Financial conditions are loose
conditions.rationale: Same clause; the level band, not the change

conditions.statement_en: Real yields are falling
conditions.rationale: The parent's "real-rate velocity". Inflation pressure that eases in an orderly way is read with real yields easing alongside it; rising real yields are the opposite side. Identical to GD-1

conditions.statement_en: Inflation composition
conditions.rationale: Named by the parent; no owner verdict audited

paths.assumption_en: Lower yield pressure comes with weakening activity and financing conditions.

conditions.statement_en: Real yields are falling
conditions.rationale: "Lower yield pressure"; identical to OD-7 by R-H

conditions.statement_en: The labour read is cooling
conditions.rationale: "Weakening activity"; mirror of OD-3

conditions.statement_en: The owner's credit-stress flag is on
conditions.rationale: "Weakening financing conditions"; mirror of OD-4; guarded by R-C

conditions.statement_en: Financial conditions are tight
conditions.rationale: Mirror of OD-5

conditions.statement_en: Real activity is weakening
conditions.rationale: The one composite that exists has legs of unequal freshness (A.2)

conditions.statement_en: Earnings context
conditions.rationale: Per-theme sign rules only; no market-level verdict

conditions.statement_en: Dollar behaviour
conditions.rationale: Readable once slice E0 publishes the number and its date; no side authored

conditions.statement_en: Credit spreads are wide in level
conditions.rationale: The owner bands the change in spreads, not their level

paths.assumption_en: Price pressure broadens or persists rather than a single transitory print.

conditions.statement_en: The recent pace of core inflation is above its 12-month pace
conditions.rationale: Mirror of OD-1

conditions.statement_en: Core inflation is above the owner's 1.7–2.3% band
conditions.rationale: "Persists"; the band is the owner's, not a policy statement

conditions.statement_en: Market-implied inflation expectations are drifting up against the model estimate (same tenors as OD-2)
conditions.rationale: Mirror of OD-2

conditions.statement_en: Breakevens are rising
conditions.rationale: The parent's "breakevens (with liquidity caveats)"; the caveat is shown beside it from the cause badge (A.2)

conditions.statement_en: Wage and services inflation are firming
conditions.rationale: Numbers are published; no owner token

conditions.statement_en: The market prices rate rises over the next 12 months
conditions.rationale: The parent's "policy repricing"

conditions.statement_en: Inflation is broadening across components
conditions.rationale: "Broadens … rather than a single transitory print"

conditions.statement_en: Oil mechanism
conditions.rationale: The only owner token is a bare sign

paths.assumption_en: Long-end yields rise for reasons the near-term policy path does not capture.

conditions.statement_en: The term-premium estimate is rising
conditions.rationale: One model's estimate; LP-6 says agreement between models is unread

conditions.statement_en: Real yields are rising
conditions.rationale: Mirror of OD-7 and GD-1

conditions.statement_en: The curve is steepening from the long end
conditions.rationale: Bare signs of a 21-observation change

conditions.statement_en: Issuance and demand at the long end are deteriorating
conditions.rationale: Named by the parent; no owner

conditions.statement_en: Term-premium models agree
conditions.rationale: One estimate is published; cross-model disagreement is not measured

conditions.statement_en: The rise in long-end yields is not explained by the priced policy path
conditions.rationale: The path's defining claim. No owner decomposes it, and the direction of priced policy alone is not evidence either way

paths.assumption_en: A price or yield reversal is visible but durable fundamental confirmation is incomplete.

conditions.statement_en: The owner flags a turn forming in the 10-year yield
conditions.rationale: "A reversal is visible". The owner's extreme tokens mean stretched and not turning — the opposite; null means it flags nothing. The parent names "multi-horizon yield turns"; the other tenors' flags are shown in Now, not read into the card

conditions.statement_en: Positioning is stretched
conditions.rationale: Named by the parent; no owner

conditions.statement_en: Later macro data have not confirmed the move
conditions.rationale: The path's defining claim; no owner verdict. Inflation and labour evidence is shown beside the card, not read into it: which side confirms depends on the direction of the turn

conditions.statement_en: Market breadth confirms the turn
conditions.rationale: Named by the parent without a side. Which side confirms depends on the direction of the turn, as for TP-5; an equity-breadth side for a rates turn would be authored

paths.assumption_en: Index strength stays carried by a narrow group while the rest lags.

conditions.statement_en: The index is within 3% of its high while the share of stocks above their 200-day average is in the lower 40% of its own history
conditions.rationale: "Index strength carried by a narrow group", in the owner's exact construction

conditions.statement_en: The owner's credit-stress flag is off
conditions.rationale: "Credit and funding stability"; identical to OD-4

conditions.statement_en: Financial conditions are loose
conditions.rationale: Identical to OD-5

conditions.statement_en: Cap-weighted returns are ahead of equal-weighted
conditions.rationale: Named by the parent; no owner on `origin/main`

conditions.statement_en: The same leaders persist
conditions.rationale: Named by the parent; no owner

conditions.statement_en: The breadth component reads strong
conditions.rationale: "Participation widens". It re-bands SC-1's input and subtracts for SC-1's flag (when the flag is true the tone is `bad` by construction), so the two are one family and never two confirmations

conditions.statement_en: Dispersion is falling without correlation rising
conditions.rationale: The owner publishes a level tercile and a proxy number; neither is the change the parent names

conditions.statement_en: Revision breadth is widening
conditions.rationale: "With fundamental support"; per-theme sign rules only

conditions.statement_en: Participation is rising on a fixed historical universe
conditions.rationale: Needs historical membership (slice D1)

paths.assumption_en: Leadership rotates inside a healthy theme or market.

conditions.statement_en: The owner's leader-damage monitor for the tracked AI-hardware cohort reads intact
conditions.rationale: "No absolute damage to the cohort", limited to the cohort and monitor that exist; the drawdown numbers and the date the state was entered (`state_since`) are shown beside it

conditions.statement_en: Leaders are turning over inside a theme
conditions.rationale: The path's defining claim; no owner

conditions.statement_en: Theme-level participation is holding
conditions.rationale: No theme-level participation verdict

paths.assumption_en: Weakness in non-leaders reaches the leaders.

conditions.statement_en: The owner's leader-damage monitor for the tracked AI-hardware cohort reads cracking or broken
conditions.rationale: Mirror of LH-1

conditions.statement_en: The owner's credit-stress flag is on
conditions.rationale: Identical to GD-3

conditions.statement_en: Financial conditions are tight
conditions.rationale: Identical to GD-4

conditions.statement_en: Correlation is rising together with dispersion
conditions.rationale: Named by the parent

conditions.statement_en: Funding and credit are worsening
conditions.rationale: "Worsening" is a change; the owner's change tokens are bare signs. DS-2 and DS-3 read levels and a flag
